description: In a Microsoft Fabric App built on Rayfin's data app template: runs one chart's DAX query through the project's own `fabric-app-data` CLI, renames the `Table[Column]` and `[Measure]` headers to plain names (the names the chart.component.tsx that generate_chart writes will match on live rows), saves EVERY row as CSV, reads each column's role, format and description from the model, and profiles the result. Replaces the query, rename, save and profile steps with one call, and returns the arguments to pass to list_eligible_charts and generate_chart. Write the query at the chart's grain (one row per country for a country map). Local: the data goes only where the project's CLI already sends it, and nothing reaches the chart server.

alias.description: The semantic model's alias in fabric.yaml. Needed only when the active profile has more than one.

dax.description: The chart's DAX query (EVALUATE ...). Or pass dax_file.

dax_file.description: Path to a .dax file holding the query, instead of dax.

name.description: A file name for this chart's data, e.g. "region-map" (saved as <name>.csv).

out_dir.description: Where to save the CSV. Defaults to <project_dir>/.bic/data.

project_dir.description: The Fabric App project folder (holds fabric.yaml and node_modules). Defaults to the folder setup_fabric_app used, else the working directory or the one Fabric App folder directly inside it.

name: query_semantic_model
title: Query the semantic model for a chart
